## Fix ObjectForm MSW Test Failure

### Investigation Summary
The CI test for `ObjectForm.msw.test.tsx` is failing because the form gets stuck in "Loading form..." state.

### Root Cause Analysis
- [x] Identify failing test: `ObjectForm.msw.test.tsx > loads schema and renders form fields`
- [x] Verify test passes locally after building packages
- [x] Analyze CI logs showing form timeout
- [x] Compare CI vs local test execution patterns
- [x] Increase waitFor timeout as potential fix
- [ ] Verify fix passes in CI
- [ ] Run all tests to ensure no regressions

### Changes Made
- Increased `waitFor` timeout from default (1s) to 5s in the first test
- Removed debug file from commit

### Testing Status
- ✅ Test passes locally with increased timeout
- ⏳ Awaiting CI validation

### Next Steps
Monitoring CI to see if timeout increase resolves the issue.
